Subject: Re: Rerank pilot next steps / initial model-fit results

Hi John / Priya —

We ran the initial model-fit evaluation on the dataset you provided (attached results). Summary highlights below — full CSV attached (rdw_rerank_eval_results_20260808.csv).

Top-level summary (test split):
- Baseline (your current ranker): NDCG@10 = 0.412, MRR = 0.238
- Redwood-rerank-v1 (dense + cross-encoder): NDCG@10 = 0.444 (+7.8%), MRR = 0.257 (+8.0%)
- Redwood-rerank-quant (8-bit quantized variant): NDCG@10 = 0.438 (+6.3%), MRR = 0.254 (+6.7%)
- Instruction-tuned-rerank (tuned on in-domain click data): NDCG@10 = 0.452 (+9.7%), MRR = 0.269 (+13.0%)

Observations / regression risk:
- Instruction-tuned-rerank shows the strongest quality gains but has slightly higher variance on short, ambiguous queries (lower P@1 consistency). We flagged 120 queries where position swaps could change top-1 item.
- Quantized variant reduces cost by ~35% in our estimate with a small drop in NDCG (~0.6–1.5 points relative to the non-quantized v1).
- Latency: on our p3-like throughput profile, pure cross-encoder adds ~22ms P95; quantized variant adds ~18ms P95. Both are within your 30ms target in our tests but we recommend in-prod smoke tests.

Recommended next steps / A/B plan:
1) Short A/B test (4 weeks) comparing: control (baseline) vs instruction-tuned-rerank (50% traffic) with a smaller holdout (10% of requests) for manual review of top swaps.
2) Run a parallel quantized candidate in shadow mode to validate cost/latency tradeoffs before rolling to production.
3) Create a prompt-set driven monitoring suite (we included the prompt set you provided plus 25 seeded regression prompts) to detect regressions and alert at a 2% NDCG drop threshold.

Attachments included: rdw_rerank_eval_results_20260808.csv, rerank_ab_plan.md (A/B test details + monitoring checklist). We also uploaded the eval run to the shared drive (link below).

Let us know if you want us to:
- Spin up a canary on dedicated capacity for a live smoke test (quote required).
- Prepare the DocuSign SOW to cover the pilot (we can have a draft ready by next Tue).

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
